title: PanGu-α Technical Paper Submission
summary: The PanGu-α authors submitted the paper "PanGu-α: Large-scale Autoregressive Pretrained Chinese Language Models with Auto-parallel Computation" on April 26, 2021. The paper documents autoregressive language models with up to 200 billion parameters, developed with MindSpore and trained using 2048 Ascend 910 AI processors on 1.1 TB of Chinese pretraining data.
significance: A primary technical-publication milestone documenting PanGu-α, a large-scale Chinese autoregressive pretrained language-model effort in 2021.

verification.note: The authors' primary paper record supplies the April 26, 2021 submission date and directly documents PanGu-α models up to 200 billion parameters, MindSpore-based development, training on 2048 Ascend 910 processors, and 1.1 TB of Chinese pretraining data. Huawei's retrospective account separately states that the Pangu large model was officially released in April 2021. This candidate is intentionally limited to the paper-submission milestone; it does not convert Huawei's month-level release statement into an exact launch day and does not infer system-birth date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
